* ** *Tunay na Iskolar ng Bayan* Scholarship Recipient** (2020)
  * Selected for a fully funded scholarship to pursue Cambridge IGCSE and A-Levels at a British International School.
  * Granted the opportunity to undergo rigorous Cambridge IGCSE and A-Level styling in Cebu, Philippines. This international training instilled a deep global research perspective and molded my trajectory to pursue early, highly specialized technical disciplines.
